verses.en: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?
verses.pt: Deus, por que nos rejeitaste para sempre? Por que tua ira fumega contra as ovelhas do teu pasto?
verses.en_web: God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
verses.en_bbe: <Maschil. Of Asaph.> Of God, why have you put us away from you for ever? why is the fire of your wrath smoking against the sheep who are your care?

verses.en: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.
verses.pt: Lembra-te do teu povo, que tu compraste desde a antiguidade; a tribo de tua herança, que resgataste; o monte Sião, em que habitaste.
verses.en_web: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance; Mount Zion, in which you have lived.
verses.en_bbe: Keep in mind your band of worshippers, for whom you gave payment in the days which are past, whom you took for yourself as the people of your heritage; even this mountain of Zion, which has been your resting-place.

verses.en: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.
verses.pt: Percorre as ruínas duradouras, tudo que o inimigo destruiu no santuário.
verses.en_web: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.
verses.en_bbe: Go up and see the unending destruction; all the evil which your haters have done in the holy place;

verses.en: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.
verses.pt: Os teus inimigos rugiram no meio de tuas assembleias; puseram por sinais de vitória os símbolos deles.
verses.en_web: Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.
verses.en_bbe: Sending out their voices like lions among your worshippers; they have put up their signs to be seen.

verses.en: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.
verses.pt: Eles eram como o que levantam machados contra os troncos das árvores.
verses.en_web: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.
verses.en_bbe: They are cutting down, like a man whose blade is lifted up against the thick trees.

verses.en: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.
verses.pt: E agora, com machados e martelos, quebraram todas as obras entalhadas.
verses.en_web: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.
verses.en_bbe: Your doors are broken down with hammers and iron blades.

verses.en: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.
verses.pt: Puseram fogo no teu santuário; profanaram levando ao chão o lugar onde o teu nome habita.
verses.en_web: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.
verses.en_bbe: They have put on fire your holy place; they have made the place of your name unclean, pulling it down to the earth.

verses.en: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.
verses.pt: Disseram em seus corações: Nós os destruiremos por completo; serão queimadas todas as assembleias de Deus na terra.
verses.en_web: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.
verses.en_bbe: They have said in their hearts, Let us put an end to them all together; they have given over to the fire all God's places of worship in the land.

verses.en: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.
verses.pt: Já não vemos os nossos sinais; já não há mais profeta; e ninguém entre nós sabe até quando será assim.
verses.en_web: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.
verses.en_bbe: We do not see our signs: there is no longer any prophet, or anyone among us to say how long.

verses.en: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?
verses.pt: Deus, até quando o adversário insultará? O inimigo blasfemará o teu nome para sempre?
verses.en_web: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?
verses.en_bbe: O God, how long will those who are against us say cruel things? will the hater go on looking down on your name for ever?

verses.en: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.
verses.pt: Por que está afastada a tua mão direita? Tira-a do teu peito!
verses.en_web: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!
verses.en_bbe: Why are you keeping back your hand, and covering your right hand in your robe?

verses.en: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
verses.pt: Deus é o meu Rei desde a antiguidade; ele opera salvação no meio da terra.
verses.en_web: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth.
verses.en_bbe: For from the past God is my King, working salvation in the earth.

verses.en: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.
verses.pt: Tu dividiste o mar com a tua força; quebraste as cabeças dos monstros nas águas.
verses.en_web: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.
verses.en_bbe: The sea was parted in two by your strength; the heads of the great sea-beasts were broken.

verses.en: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.
verses.pt: Despedaçaste as cabeças do leviatã; e o deste como alimento ao povo do deserto.
verses.en_web: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.
verses.en_bbe: The heads of the great snake were crushed by you; you gave them as food to the fishes of the sea.

verses.en: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.
verses.pt: Tu dividiste a fonte e o ribeiro; tu secaste os rios perenes.
verses.en_web: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.
verses.en_bbe: You made valleys for fountains and springs; you made the ever-flowing rivers dry.

verses.en: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.
verses.pt: A ti pertence o dia, a noite também é tua; tu preparaste a luz e o sol.
verses.en_web: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.
verses.en_bbe: The day is yours and the night is yours: you made the light and the sun.

verses.en: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.
verses.pt: Tu estabeleceste todos os limites da terra; tu formaste o verão e o inverno.
verses.en_web: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.
verses.en_bbe: By you all the limits of the earth were fixed; you have made summer and winter.

verses.en: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O LORD, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.
verses.pt: Lembra-te disto: que o inimigo insultou ao SENHOR; e um povo tolo blasfemou o teu nome.
verses.en_web: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, Yahweh. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.
verses.en_bbe: Keep this in mind, O Lord, that your haters have said cruel things, and that your name has been looked down on by a people of evil behaviour.

verses.en: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.
verses.pt: Não entregues a vida da tua pombinha para os animais selvagens; não te esqueças para sempre da vida dos teus pobres.
verses.en_web: Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.
verses.en_bbe: O give not the soul of your dove to the hawk; let not the life of the poor go out of your memory for ever.

verses.en: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.
verses.pt: Olha para o teu pacto, porque os lugares escuros da terra estão cheios de habitações violentas.
verses.en_web: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.
verses.en_bbe: Keep in mind your undertaking; for the dark places of the earth are full of pride and cruel acts.

verses.en: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.
verses.pt: Não permitas que o oprimido volte humilhado; que o aflito e o necessitado louvem o teu nome.
verses.en_web: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.
verses.en_bbe: O let not the crushed be turned back in shame; let the low man and the poor give praise to your name.

verses.en: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.
verses.pt: Levanta-te, Deus; luta em favor de tua causa; lembra-te do insulto que o tolo faz a ti o dia todo.
verses.en_web: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.
verses.en_bbe: Up! O God, be the judge of your cause; keep in mind the bitter things which the man of evil behaviour says against you every day.

verses.en: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.
verses.pt: Não te esqueças da voz dos teus adversários; o barulho dos que se levantam contra ti sobe cada vez mais. Para o regente, conforme “altachete”; salmo e cântico de Asafe:
verses.en_web: Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.
verses.en_bbe: Keep in mind the voice of your haters; the outcry of those who come against you goes up every day.
